0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, riding a three-game win streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-6, on a five-game losing streak) in the Pelicans' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Pelicans are without Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The 2026-27 season series is tied... wait, correction: in the 2026-27 season so far, the Pelicans trail 0-1 after losing 120-119 in Salt Lake City on October 23, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
